result.summary: Fixes or removes several stale, undefined, or mismatched C++ function declarations across RPC, common, Qt, and HTTP headers. Functions that were defined locally without matching public declarations are either marked static or have their header declarations corrected.
result.problem: Dead and mismatched function declarations clutter headers, mislead developers, and prevent the build system from enabling compiler flags like -Wmissing-declarations or -Wmissing-prototypes.
evidence: Split out of #36743: 'Ideally we can have the compiler enforce/flag this in future.' (PR description)

Individual commit messages detail declarations left behind after definitions were deleted (e.g., bad11ff68e) or functions declared with different types than their actual implementation (410843a684, 5f972485ff).
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; the commit breakdown and diff remain the same.
result.card: Cleans up several stale, undefined, or mismatched function declarations across RPC, Qt, HTTP, and common headers. Removing dead declarations and marking internal functions static prevents signature mismatches and cleans up header interfaces. This work was split out of PR 36743 to help enable compiler flags such as -Wmissing-declarations.

risk.why: Only removes dead declarations, corrects matching types on a declaration, and restricts internal functions to internal linkage.
